description: POST two JSON Schemas or OpenAPI documents as old and new. Returns breaking and non-breaking changes with JSON pointers and reason codes: removed properties, new required fields, narrowed types, enums and bounds, removed paths, operations, parameters and responses. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
